breakdown.description: Steady Bernoulli is applied to a rapid transient (water hammer); unsteady compressibility/elasticity effects dominate.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly repeats the original error by applying the steady Bernoulli equation (ΔP = ½ρ(V₁²−V₂²)) to this rapid transient event. The ground truth requires treating this as a water-hammer problem using Δp = ρaΔV and explicitly states not to use steady Bernoulli. The agent not only failed to correct the error but fully embraced it, even dismissing the 0.05 s closure time as merely 'provided for context.'
